title: Repository
description: The directory that holds `.engineering/`, observed on disk.

engineering.description: `<root>/<project directory>`: reverse.rs:1354 (`root.join(project_directory())`); migrate_git.rs:255-257 reads the root back as that directory's parent.

directory_name.description: The root's last path component, made absolute and canonicalized where it can be, lossily decoded: store_command.rs:138-145 (`planning_scope`).

planning_has_entries.description: `.engineering/planning/` reads as a directory holding an entry: reverse.rs:1370-1371.

evidence_has_entries.description: `.engineering/evidence/` reads as a directory holding an entry: migrate_git.rs:273, 277.

engineering_clean.description: `git status --porcelain -- .` run in `.engineering/` prints nothing: migrate_git.rs:263-270 and 367-382 (`git_clean`).

in_git_repository.description: The root is inside a Git work tree: a `.git` entry above it leads to a common directory (crates/edge/aep-cli/src/planning_writer_fence.rs:66, `git_common_directory`).

origin_repository_name.description: The last path segment of the `origin` remote's URL with a trailing `.git` removed; absent when there is no Git repository or it has no `origin` remote: store_command.rs:147-148, 170-198 (`origin_url`, `repository_name_of_url`).

git_common_directory_holder.description: The name of the directory holding the Git common directory, present only when that directory is named `.git`. In a linked worktree this is the primary checkout, not the worktree's own directory: store_command.rs:150-156.
